'''Qa'till''' was a member of the [[Laboi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Gaining control of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] maintenance on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hypotria]], Qa'till became a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. Some of the Laboi's employees killed a deep-cover [[R2z-DL's operative|Rebel agent]], who was also the owner of [[R2z-DL]].<ref name="CRO" />
